# Architecture firm in Cluj-Napoca

Beletage is a Romanian-German architecture firm in Cluj-Napoca, founded in 2012. We design homes, residential buildings and commercial spaces, and we prepare urban planning documentation — from the first sketch all the way to the building permit and construction. If you're looking for an architect in Cluj who will see your project through to the end, not just draw you a façade, you're in the right place.

## Architecture services in Cluj-Napoca

- Residential design — single-family houses, duplexes, apartment buildings. From concept to technical design and construction details.
- Commercial and office design — workspaces, mixed-use developments, administrative buildings.
- Urban planning — zonal and detailed urban plans (PUZ / PUD — zonal and detailed urban development plans), for land subdivisions, ensembles and developments.
- Permitting and approvals — we coordinate the entire process: certificat de urbanism (urban planning certificate), site studies, the building permit design (DTAC — the documentation submitted to obtain a building permit), avize (official approvals from authorities and utilities) and the filing of the dossier.
- Design and consultancy — from organising the space to choosing the materials.
